MasterReference.name: Master Reference
MasterReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for a group of individual orders, as assigned by the instructing party. This identifier links the individual orders together.

OrderDateTime.name: Order Date Time
OrderDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the order was placed by the investor.

InvestmentAccountDetails.name: Investment Account Details
InvestmentAccountDetails.definition: Account between an investor(s) and a fund manager or a fund. The account can contain holdings in any investment fund or investment fund class managed (or distributed) by the fund manager, within the same fund family.

DealReference.name: Deal Reference
DealReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for an order execution, as assigned by a confirming party.

OrderReference.name: Order Reference
OrderReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for an order, as assigned by the instructing party.

ClientReference.name: Client Reference
ClientReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous investor's identification of an order. This reference can typically be used in a hub scenario to give the reference of the order as assigned by the underlying client.

TotalRedemptionAmount.name: Total Redemption Amount
TotalRedemptionAmount.definition: Amount of money used to determine the quantity of investment fund units to be redeemed.

TotalSubscriptionAmount.name: Total Subscription Amount
TotalSubscriptionAmount.definition: Amount of money used to determine the quantity of investment fund units to be subscribed.

RelatedPartyDetails.name: Related Party Details
RelatedPartyDetails.definition: Confirmation of the information about parties related to the transaction.

RequestedFutureTradeDate.name: Requested Future Trade Date
RequestedFutureTradeDate.definition: Future date at which the investor requests the order to be executed.|The specification of a requested future trade date is not allowed in some markets. The date must be a date in the future.

AdditionalCashIn.name: Additional Cash In
AdditionalCashIn.definition: Additional amount of money paid by the investor in addition to the switch redemption amount.

ResultingCashOut.name: Resulting Cash Out
ResultingCashOut.definition: Amount of money that results from a switch-out, that is not reinvested in another investment fund, and is repaid to the investor.

SettlementAmount.name: Settlement Amount
SettlementAmount.definition: Total amount of money paid /to be paid or received in exchange for the financial instrument in the individual order.

CashSettlementDate.name: Cash Settlement Date
CashSettlementDate.definition: Date on which cash is available.

SettlementMethod.name: Settlement Method
SettlementMethod.definition: Method by which the transaction is settled.

BestExecution.name: Best Execution
BestExecution.definition: Specifies that the execution was subject to best execution rules as defined by MiFID.

RedemptionLegDetails.name: Redemption Leg Details
RedemptionLegDetails.definition: Redemption leg of a switch order execution.

SubscriptionLegDetails.name: Subscription Leg Details
SubscriptionLegDetails.definition: Subscription leg of a switch order execution.

CashSettlementDetails.name: Cash Settlement Details
CashSettlementDetails.definition: Payment transaction resulting from the investment fund order execution.

ForeignExchangeDetails.name: Foreign Exchange Details
ForeignExchangeDetails.definition: Currency exchange related to the execution of an investment fund order.

FinancialAdvice.name: Financial Advice
FinancialAdvice.definition: Specifies if advice has been received from an independent financial advisor.

NegotiatedTrade.name: Negotiated Trade
NegotiatedTrade.definition: Specifies whether the trade is negotiated.

LateReport.name: Late Report
LateReport.definition: Specifies whether the order execution confirmation is late.

InvestmentAccountDetailsRule.definition: Either InvestmentAccountDetails or (all occurrences of SubscriptionLegDetails/InvestmentAccountDetails and of RedemptionLegDetails/InvestmentAccountDetails) must be present, but not both.

OrderOriginatorEligibilityRule.definition: Either InvestmentAccountDetails/OrderOriginatorEligibility or a single occurrence of RedemptionLegDetails/InvestmentAccountDetails/OrderOriginatorEligibility or a single occurrence of SubscriptionLegDetails/InvestmentAccountDetails/OrderOriginatorEligibility should be only present.

CashInOrCashOutRule.definition: Either AdditionalCashIn or ResultingCashOut may be present, but not both.
